mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, sort, icon, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{sort}, #{icon}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name = #{name}, sort = #{sort}, icon = #{icon}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, sort, icon, status, create_time, update_time FROM category WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, sort, icon, status, create_time, update_time FROM category WHERE name = #{name}

SELECT id, name, sort, icon, status, create_time, update_time FROM category
AND status = #{status}
AND name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, sort, icon, status, create_time, update_time FROM category WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
